after.name: _ollama
after.note:
Template for a local model in Ollama, through its native API. Create a profile from it on the
Configuration page and set the model: a tag listed by `ollama list` (download it first with
`ollama pull <model>`). Nothing is billed and no key is needed. Ollama cloud models are refused.

Context window: options.num_ctx in the request options is required. The server default depends
on the GPU (4096 tokens with less than 24 GB of VRAM) and would cut the larger prompts; the adapter
sends num_ctx with every request and makes the server refuse a prompt that does not fit. The
prompt plus the output limit must fit: DayTrader, the largest application, has about 10,100
prompt tokens with Qwen 3.5, so num_ctx 32768 with an output limit of 16384 fits every application.

Seed: leave it empty. Each attempt gets its own seed, derived from the master seed of the
experiment, so the runs differ and each attempt can be repeated with the same machine, Ollama
version and model digest.

Temperature: empty uses the model's own default (Modelfile parameters, recorded with each variant).

Thinking, for models that have it (`ollama show <model>` lists the levels): "think": true or
false, or "low" / "medium" / "high" for gpt-oss, e.g.
{"think": "high", "options": {"num_ctx": 32768}}

Other model options (top_p, top_k, ...) go under "options". The study does not use "format"
(structured output): the treatment is the same prompt sent to the hosted models.

Machine of the study: RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6 GB), Ryzen 7 7735HS, 31 GB of RAM. Models larger
than about 4B parameters run partly on the CPU with a 32k context.

after.name: _openai_compatible
after.note:
Template for a server that implements the Chat Completions API: vLLM, LM Studio or a hosted
gateway (OpenRouter, DeepSeek). Create a profile from it on the Configuration page.

For Ollama, use the provider ollama (template _ollama) instead. Through this endpoint the
context window cannot be set per request, so the server default applies (4096 tokens with less
than 24 GB of VRAM) and longer prompts are cut without warning; nor are the model digest and
the server version recorded.

api_key_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"   # hosted gateways need a key; local servers do not

input_per_mtok = 0
output_per_mtok = 0

after.name: gpt-oss-20b-high
after.note:
Open-weight replication, outside the main factor (roteiro: a second model, with open weights, as a
separate replication). gpt-oss:20b in Ollama 0.40.15: MoE with 20.9B parameters, MXFP4, digest
f38aa0c53da5 (downloaded on 2026-11-06).

Thinking "high", as reasoning_effort = "high" in the hosted profiles. Temperature empty: the
Modelfile default (temperature 1). Output limit 32000, as in the hosted profiles; num_ctx 49152
holds the largest prompt (DayTrader, about 10,100 tokens) plus the output limit.

On the study machine (RTX 4050 Laptop GPU with 6 GB, Ryzen 7 7735HS, 31 GB of RAM) about a quarter
of the model fits in GPU memory; the rest runs on the CPU. Pilot measurements on JPetStore with
thinking high (2026-11-06): 5.5 to 9 minutes per attempt, 5,400 to 7,800 output tokens.

after.name: qwen3.5-4b-think
after.note:

parameters, Q4_K_M, digest d8b0f5e9760c (downloaded on 2026-11-06). It fits in the 6 GB of GPU memory.

Thinking on (its levels are on and off; on is its default). Temperature empty: the Modelfile
